purpose: Bounded no-label read probe to ground the postboot complete-panel cold-I/O reserve.

authorization.scope: Exactly four sequential reads of one already accepted warm-control prediction NPY; no global cache drop, target access, GPU work, payload mutation, or new artifact generation.

method.cache_advisory: Opened a file-specific read-only descriptor and requested POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED before each pass.

limitations: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED is advisory; successful eviction and physical cold-read status were not verified.
This four-pass 300 MB artifact probe does not establish sustained throughput for the approximately 31.86 GB sequence caches or their repeated full-panel scans.
The accepted artifact digest was pinned from its acceptance receipt and was not recomputed as an extra data pass.
